Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly inferred from the IMDb page that the “Narrator (voice)” credit (Jeremy Davidson) corresponds to the title character Jason Bourne. This misinterpretation of the credits led the investigation toward the wrong actor instead of recognizing that The Bourne Betrayal is a novel (with no widely released film of that exact title) and that the title character Jason Bourne is portrayed by Matt Damon in the main film series.
